trace.notes: The original zbMATH URL returned a Cloudflare challenge from local fetching. zbMATH REST API identifier-specific recovery succeeded only as resolver metadata and identified the work as Zbl 0542.05002, title Unsolved problems, DOI 10.1007/BFb0073130, in Graph Theory Singapore 1983, Lecture Notes in Mathematics 1073, pages 324-335.
